title: A sound comes back
hook: A signal can reveal an object without touching it.

knows: Animals have body structures and life histories.
doesNotKnow: Trace an outgoing signal and its returning echo.

misconception: A familiar animal feature always has the first explanation that comes to mind.
objective: Trace an outgoing signal and its returning echo.

claims.text: A bat emits a sound toward an insect. Which event is needed for an echo to reach the bat? The outgoing path reaches the insect; the returning path represents reflected sound reaching the bat. Many bats use returning echoes to help locate objects. The diagram is a schematic, not an observation or a statement that bats cannot see.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: National Park Service, bats and echolocation, https://www.nps.gov/subjects/bats/echolocation.htm

claims.text: The diagram and its labels are schematic, not to scale and not an observation. Sound paths · schematic
A click reflects from a wall back to its source. Which part of the trip is the echo? An echo is sound that returns after reflection.
claims.source: Source lead, not checked: National Park Service, bats and echolocation, https://www.nps.gov/subjects/bats/echolocation.htm
